label: EU-ehds-2025 Article 79

obligations.text: The Commission shall establish an EU dataset catalogue connecting the national dataset catalogues established by the health data access bodies in each Member State as well as the dataset catalogues of authorised participants in HealthData@EU.
The EU dataset catalogue, the national dataset catalogues and the dataset catalogues of authorised participants in HealthData@EU shall be made publicly available.
